name: smwgraphics-illusion-of-gaia-ending
title: Illusion of Gaia - Ending
description:
The background seem in the ending sequence of Illusion of Gaia. It does not scroll by default, so you must find a way to loop the background. A great fit for a city level. But please make sure to adjust the background or use it with no scrolling at all. Part of my C3 2022 Summer thread.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
